title: Reported procedural update:additional serious felony charges considered against Elizabeth Siders

data.claim: The U.S. Sun reported on August 18 that Prosecutor William Archer, responding to Elizabeth Siders' release request, said a grand jury was considering additional serious felony charges against her. The report did not identify the potential charges.
data.notes: Potential charges are not represented as filed or adjudicated; official docket verification remains outstanding.
